changes.released: cast(x,y,side=0){if(minorReserveEnded(this))return {ok:false,reason:'The battle has ended.'};if(this.limitReason)return {ok:false,code:'save-safety-limit',reason:this.limitReason};const s=this.state;if(s.winner!==null||![0,1].includes(side)||!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<0||x>this.map.width||y<0||y>this.map.height)return {ok:false,reason:'Choose a point on the battlefield.'};if(supportsFog(this.ruleset)&&!isPointVisible(this,side,x,y))return {ok:false,code:'fog-hidden-aim',reason:'Volley needs a currently visible aim point.'};if(s.spellCooldown[side]>0)return {ok:false,reason:'Volley is recharging.'};if(s.gold[side]<SPELL.cost)return {ok:false,reason:`Need ${SPELL.cost} gold.`};s.gold[side]-=SPELL.cost;s.spellCooldown[side]=SPELL.cooldown;for(const u of s.units)if(u.side!==side&&Math.hypot(u.x-x,u.y-y)<SPELL.radius)this._damage(u,SPELL.damage,side);this._effect(x,y,'volley',side,1.1,SPELL.radius);if(supportsFog(this.ruleset))refreshFog(this);return {ok:true};}
